events.summary: Bank of America cut Dutch peer BE Semiconductor (Besi) to neutral from buy and nearly halved its target, saying Besi's price does not reflect the threat of ASML entering hybrid bonding (a chip-packaging machine market Besi leads). Besi fell as much as 6.4% on Tuesday. ASML has not announced a hybrid-bonding product; CEO Christophe Fouquet said in April 2026 that ASML 'continues to look at supporting customers in hybrid bonding', and ASML shipped its first advanced-packaging product in 2025 (per The Next Web). Korea's The Elec reported in March 2026 that ASML is developing a hybrid bonder (via TrendForce).
events.why_it_matters: For ASML this is a possible new, small market beyond lithography; for Besi it is a threat. It is analyst opinion plus an unconfirmed report, not an ASML announcement. Not a cause of ASML's fall (ASML is the potential winner in the story).

products.name: Hybrid bonding equipment (possible ASML entry; not announced)
products.what_it_is: A machine that joins two chips (or wafers) face to face, copper contact to copper contact, with no solder bumps in between.
products.analogy: Like pressing two Lego plates together so every stud lines up exactly, instead of gluing them with blobs of solder: tighter, thinner and it lets heat escape better.
products.buyers: Makers of stacked memory for AI (HBM) and advanced chip packaging; The Elec/TrendForce call it key equipment for next-generation HBM.
products.how_it_works: Both surfaces are polished extremely flat, aligned to tiny tolerances and bonded directly, so contacts can sit much closer together and heat moves out of the chip more effectively (The Next Web, 2026-10-06).
products.sales: ASML: none (no hybrid-bonding product announced). Labelled proxy: market leader Besi's cumulative hybrid-bonding orders above 150 tools (Besi 2025 annual report, per The Next Web); UBS estimates hybrid-bonding revenue of about EUR 424m in 2030 (search summary, UBS note not read).
products.sales_source: https://thenextweb.com/news/besi-asml-hybrid-bonding-dutch (tier 3); UBS figure from search summary only
products.stage: Exploring / reportedly in development: CEO said in April 2026 ASML 'continues to look at supporting customers in hybrid bonding'; The Elec reported development in March 2026.
products.size_for_company: Small even if ASML won share: UBS's ~EUR 0.42bn 2030 estimate for the whole market is about 1% of ASML's 2026 guided sales of EUR 43-45bn (computed, using a tier-3-reported estimate).
products.competition: Besi is the leader (Bernstein expects Besi to make about three of every four hybrid bonders shipped in 2028, per The Next Web); others not verified here.
products.why_investors_care: A new market beyond lithography where ASML's precision could help; mainly a threat to Besi rather than a big profit driver for ASML.
products.watch_next: Any mention of hybrid bonding or advanced packaging on ASML's Q3 call, 2026-10-14.
